# ecosim.in — 판독 구간 기록

구간은 1행부터 1528행까지 빈틈없이 이어진다.

| 1–38 | EcoSim Biological Model Parameters / 입력 문법 — 제목·저작권·라이선스 주석을 포함한다(2–9). 키워드 순서, 주석, 빈 줄, 이어쓰기(continuation), 마지막 값의 배열 반복, 곱셈 표기와 격자(grid)별 배열 순서를 설명한다(11–35). 원문: `!  EcoSim Biological Model Parameters.` (2); `! git $Id$` (4); `!========================================================= Hernan G. Arango ===` (5); `!  Copyright (c) 2002-2026 The ROMS Group                   W. Paul Bissett   !` (6); `!    Licensed under a MIT/X style license                                     !` (7); `!    See License_ROMS.md                                                      !` (8); `!==============================================================================` (9); `!                                                                             !` (10); `! Input parameters can be entered in ANY order, provided that the parameter   !` (11); `! KEYWORD (usually, upper case) is typed correctly followed by "="  or "=="   !` (12); `! symbols. Any comment lines are allowed and must begin with an exclamation   !` (13); `! mark (!) in column one.  Comments may  appear to the right of a parameter   !` (14); `! specification to improve documentation.  Comments will be ignored  during   !` (15); `! reading.  Blank lines are also allowed and ignored. Continuation lines in   !` (16); `! a parameter specification are allowed and must be preceded by a backslash   !` (17); `! (\).  In some instances, more than one value is required for a parameter.   !` (18); `! If fewer values are provided, the  last value  is assigned for the entire   !` (19); `! parameter array.  The multiplication symbol (*),  without blank spaces in   !` (20); `! between, is allowed for a parameter specification.  For example, in a two   !` (21); `! grids nested application:                                                   !` (22); `!                                                                             !` (23); `!    AKT_BAK == 2*1.0d-6  2*5.0d-6              ! m2/s                        !` (24); `!                                                                             !` (25); `! indicates that the first two entries of array AKT_BAK,  in fortran column-  !` (26); `! major order, will have the same value of "1.0d-6" for grid 1,  whereas the  !` (27); `! next two entries will have the same value of "5.0d-6" for grid 2.           !` (28); `!                                                                             !` (29); `! In multiple levels of nesting and/or multiple connected domains  step-ups,  !` (30); `! "Ngrids" entries are expected for some of these parameters.  In such case,  !` (31); `! the order of the entries for a parameter is extremely important.  It  must  !` (32); `! follow the same order (1:Ngrids) as in the state variable declaration. The  !` (33); `! USER may follow the above guidelines for specifying his/her values.  These  !` (34); `! parameters are marked by "==" plural symbol after the KEYWORD.              !` (35); `!                                                                             !` (36); `!=============================================================================!` (37). |

The CPP option SPONGE is now deprecated and replaced with` (1175); `!                   this switch to facilitate or not sponge areas over a` (1176); `!                   particular nested grid; [1:NBT,1:Ngrids] values are` (1177); `!                   expected.` (1178); `!                   The horizontal mixing distribution is specified in` (1180); `!                   "ini_hmixcoef.F" as:` (1181); `!                     diff2(i,j,itrc) = diff_factor(i,j) * diff2(i,j,itrc)` (1183); `!                     diff4(i,j,itrc) = diff_factor(i,j) * diff4(i,j,itrc)` (1184); `!                   The variable "diff_factor" can be read from the grid` (1186); `!                   NetCDF file. Alternately, the horizontal diffusion in the` (1187); `!                   sponge area can be set-up with analytical functions in` (1188); `!                   "ana_sponge.h" using CPP ANA_SPONGE when these switches` (1189); `!                   are turned ON for a particular grid.` (1190); `!  AKT_BAK        Background vertical mixing coefficient (m2/s) for biological` (1192); `!                   tracer variables, [1:NBT,1:Ngrids] values are expected.` (1193). |

| 1206–1254 | Tracer advection scheme / 알고리즘·조건 — 추적자별 스위치 설정과 양의 장·온도에 대한 알고리즘 선택 설명을 적는다(1210–1216). 알고리즘 목록, 축약·대소문자 규칙, HSIMT 또는 MPDATA에서 단조성(monotonicity)을 보존하려면 수평·수직에 같은 기법을 설정해야 한다는 조건을 적는다(1218–1237). 비선형·수반 키워드의 차원을 정의한다(1239–1253). 원문: `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (1206); `! Tracer advection scheme.` (1207); `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (1208); `! It is more advantageous to set the horizontal and vertical advection schemes` (1210); `! for each tracer with switches instead of a single CPP flag for all of them.` (1211); `! Positive-definite and monotonic algorithms (i.e., MPDATA and HSIMT) are` (1212); `! appropriate and useful for positive fields like salinity, inert, biological,` (1213); `! and sediment tracers.  However, since the temperature has a dynamic range` (1214); `! with negative and positive values in the ocean, other advection schemes are` (1215); `! more appropriate.` (1216); `! Currently, the following tracer advection schemes are available and are` (1218); `! activated using the associated Keyword:` (1219); `!   Keyword    Advection Algorithm` (1221); `!   A4         4th-order Akima (horizontal/vertical)` (1223); `!   C2         2nd-order centered differences (horizontal/vertical)` (1224); `!   C4         4th-order centered differences (horizontal/vertical)` (1225); `!   HSIMT      3th-order HSIMT with TVD limiter (horizontal/vertical)` (1226); `!   MPDATA     recursive flux corrected MPDATA (horizontal/vertical)` (1227); `!   SPLINES    parabolic splines reconstruction (only vertical)` (1228); `!   SU3        split third-order upstream (horizontal/vertical)` (1229); `!   U3         3rd-order upstresm-bias (only horizontal)` (1230); `! The user has the option of specifying the full Keyword or the first` (1232); `! two letters, regardless if using uppercase or lowercase.` (1233); `! If using either HSIMT (Wu and Zhu, 2010) or MPDATA (Margolin and` (1235); `! Smolarkiewicz, 1998) options, the user needs to set the same scheme` (1236); `! for both horizontal and vertical advection to preserve monotonicity.` (1237); `! Hadvection     Horizontal advection for each active (temperature and` (1239); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids]` (1240); `!                  values are expected.` (1241); `! Vadvection     Vertical advection for each active (temperature and` (1243); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids]` (1244); `!                  values are expected.` (1245); `! ad_Hadvection  Horizontal advection for each active (temperature and` (1247); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers in the adjoint-based` (1248); `!                  algorithms, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids] values are expected.` (1249); `! ad_Vadvection  Vertical advection for each active (temperature and` (1251); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers in the adjoint-based` (1252); `!                  algorithms, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids] values are expected.` (1253). |
| 1255–1292 | Tracer advection scheme / 입력 예시 — 온도·염분·비활성 추적자(inert tracers)의 이어쓰기 예시와 중첩 격자(nested grids)별 예시를 적는다(1255–1281). 모든 수동 추적자(passive tracers)의 수평·수직 기법이 같을 때 쓰는 축약 예시를 적는다(1283–1291). 원문: `! Examples:` (1255); `!  Hadvection == A4       \                     ! temperature` (1257); `!                MPDATA   \                     ! salinity` (1258); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! dye_01, inert(1)` (1259); `!                HSIMT                          ! dy2_02, inert(2)` (1260); `!  Vadvection == A4       \                     ! temperature` (1262); `!                MPDATA   \                     ! salinity` (1263); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! dye_01, inert(1)` (1264); `!                HSIMT                          ! dye_02, inert(2)` (1265); `! or in nested applications` (1267); `!  Hadvection == U3       \                     ! temperature, Grid 1` (1269); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 1` (1270); `!                U3       \                     ! temperature, Grid 2` (1271); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 2` (1272); `!                U3       \                     ! temperature, Grid 3` (1273); `!                HSIMT                          ! salinity,    Grid 3` (1274); `!  Vadvection == C4       \                     ! temperature, Grid 1` (1276); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 1` (1277); `!                C4       \                     ! temperature, Grid 2` (1278); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 2` (1279); `!                C4       \                     ! temperature, Grid 3` (1280); `!                HSIMT                          ! salinity,    Grid 3` (1281); `! It is convinient to use the compact specification format for biological and` (1283); `! sediment passive tracers as:` (1284); `!  Hadvection == HSIMT                          ! idbio(:), compact` (1286); `!  Vadvection == HSIMT                          ! idbio(:), compact` (1288); `! when all the passive tracers have the same horizontal and vertical tracer` (1290); `! advection scheme.` (1291). |
| 1293–1317 | Lateral boundary conditions parameters / 구조·키워드 — 논리 스위치와 LBC 구조 배열의 차원을 적는다(1297–1304). 각 방향의 gradient 구성 예시, 대소문자 규칙과 RadNud 복합 조건을 적는다(1305–1316). 원문: `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (1293); `! Lateral boundary conditions parameters.` (1294); `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (1295); `! The lateral boundary conditions are now specified with logical switches` (1297); `! instead of CPP flags to allow nested grid configurations. Their values are` (1298); `! load into structured array:` (1299); `!    LBC(1:4, nLBCvar, Ngrids)` (1301); `! where 1:4 are the number of boundary edges, nLBCvar are the number LBC state` (1303); `! variables, and Ngrids is the number of nested grids. For Example, to apply` (1304); `! gradient boundary conditions to any tracer we use:` (1305); `!    LBC(iwest,  isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (1307); `!    LBC(ieast,  isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (1308); `!    LBC(isouth, isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (1309); `!    LBC(inorth, isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (1310); `! The lateral boundary conditions for biological tracers are entered with` (1312); `! a keyword. This keyword is case insensitive and usually has three characters.` (1313); `! However, it is possible to have compound keywords, if applicable. For example,` (1314); `! the keyword "RadNud" implies radiation boundary condition with nudging. This` (1315); `! combination is usually used in active/passive radiation conditions.` (1316). |
| 1318–1353 | Lateral boundary conditions / 축약 예시·도식 — 동서 주기(periodic) 적용에서 전체 생물 추적자에 한 경계 조건 항목을 쓰는 예시를 적는다(1318–1334). 경계 유형 문자 도식은 북·남·서·동을 4·2·1·3으로 배치한다(1336–1345). 비선형·수반 키워드의 차원을 적는다(1347–1352). 원문: `! It is possible to specify the lateral boundary conditions for all biological` (1318); `! tracers in a compact form with a single entry.  for example, in a East-West` (1319); `! periodic application we can just have:` (1320); `!                   W       S       E       N` (1322); `!                   e       o       a       o` (1323); `!                   s       u       s       r` (1324); `!                   t       t       t       t` (1325); `!                           h               h` (1326); `!                   1       2       3       4` (1328); `!  LBC(isTvar) ==   Per     Clo     Per     Clo` (1330); `! Then, the standard input processing routine will assume that all the` (1332); `! biological tracers have the same lateral boundary condition specified by` (1333); `! the single entry.` (1334); `!   Keyword    Lateral Boundary Condition Type` (1336); `!   Cla        Clamped                                _____N_____     j=Mm` (1338); `!   Clo        Closed                                \|     4     \|` (1339); `!   Gra        Gradient                              \|           \|` (1340); `!   Nes        Nested                              1 W           E 3` (1341); `!   Nud        Nudging                               \|           \|` (1342); `!   Per        Periodic                              \|_____S_____\|` (1343); `!   Rad        Radiation                                   2          j=1` (1344); `!                                                   i=1         i=Lm` (1345); `!  LBC(isTvar)    Biological Tracers, [1:4, 1:NBT, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1347); `! Similarly, the adjoint-based algorithms (ADM, TLM, RPM) can have different` (1349); `! lateral boundary conditions keywords:` (1350); `!  ad_LBC(isTvar) Biological Tracers, [1:4, 1:NBT, Ngrids] values are expected.` (1352). |
| 1354–1397 | Tracer point Sources/Sink sources switches — LtracerSrc의 차원과 idbio 인덱스 예시를 적는다(1355–1363). 모든 하천의 온도·염분 지정 의무, 다른 추적자의 선택성, river_flag를 대체하는 스위치와 이전 NetCDF 속성 예시, 이전 형식 호환(backward compatibility)을 설명한다(1365–1386). 해당 추적자 공급이 없는 하천도 0 값을 지정해야 하는 조건을 적는다(1388–1396). 원문: `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (1354); `!  Tracer point Sources/Sink sources switches: [1:NBT,1:Ngrids].` (1355); `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (1356); `!  LtracerSrc     Logical switches (T/F) to activate biological tracer` (1358); `!                   variables point Sources/Sinks.` (1359); `!                     LtracerSrc(idbio(  1),ng)` (1361); `!                     ...              ...` (1362); `!                     LtracerSrc(idbio(NBT),ng)` (1363); `!                   Recall that these switches are usually activated to add` (1365); `!                   river runoff as a point source. At minimum, it is necessary` (1366); `!                   to specify both temperature and salinity for all rivers.` (1367); `!                   The other tracers are optional. The user needs to know the` (1368); `!                   correspondence between biological variables and indices` (1369); `!                   idbio(1:NBT) when activating one or more of these switches.` (1370); `!                   These logical switches REPLACES and ELIMINATES the need to` (1372); `!                   have or read the variable "river_flag(river)" in the input` (1373); `!                   rivers forcing NetCDF file:` (1374); `!                     double river_flag(river)` (1376); `!                        river_flag:long_name = "river runoff tracer flag"` (1377); `!                        river_flag:option_0 = "all tracers are off"` (1378); `!                        river_flag:option_1 = "only temperature"` (1379); `!                        river_flag:option_2 = "only salinity"` (1380); `!                        river_flag:option_3 = "both temperature and salinity"` (1381); `!                        river_flag:units = "nondimensional"` (1382); `!                   This logic was too cumbersome and complicated when` (1384); `!                   additional tracers are considered. However, this change` (1385); `!                   is backward compatible.` (1386); `!                   The LtracerSrc switch will be used to activate the reading` (1388); `!                   of respective tracer variable from input river forcing` (1389); `!                   NetCDF file. If you want to add other tracer variables` (1390); `!                   (other than temperature and salinity) as a source for a` (1391); `!                   particular river(s), you just need to specify such values` (1392); `!                   on those river(s). Then, set the values to ZERO on the` (1393); `!                   other river(s) that do NOT require such river forcing for` (1394); `!                   that tracer. Recall that you need to specify the tracer` (1395); `!                   values for all rivers, even if their values are zero.` (1396). |

Currently, the CLIMA(ng)%tclm is used for` (1405); `!                   horizontal mixing, sponges, and nudging.` (1406); `!                     LtracerCLM(idbio(  1),ng)` (1408); `!                     ...              ...` (1409); `!                     LtracerCLM(idbio(NBT),ng)` (1410); `! ## 판독 중 확인된 사실 (판단 아님, 후속 검토 대상)

- 142–145: `maxC2pALG`의 설명은 C:P 비율과 `micromole_C/micromole_P` 단위를 적지만, 같은 주석은 `A value of 1.0 denotes no silica used.`라고 적는다.
- 237·261: 단위 문자열은 각각 `[(microgram_Chl_b/microgram_Chl_a)/[microgram_C/microgram_Chl_ a)],`와 `[(microgram_PSC/microgram_Chl_a)/microgram_C/microgram_Chl_a)],`이다. 237행은 두 번째 여는 대괄호 뒤에 닫는 소괄호를 쓴다. 261행은 대응하는 여는 소괄호 없이 마지막 닫는 소괄호를 쓴다.
- 280–284·975–977: `b_PPC`의 설명은 PPC:Chl_a 비율을 적지만, 두 위치의 단위는 `microgram_Chl_c/microgram_Chl_a`이다.
- 293–296·984–986: `b_LPUb`의 설명은 LPUb:Chl_a 비율을 적지만, 단위에는 HPUb를 쓴다. 293행은 `migrogram_HPUb/microgram_Chl_a`, 985행은 `microgram_HPUb/microgram_Chl_a`이다.
- 376–380·1040–1042: `C2nNupDON`의 설명은 DON 흡수가 시작하는 C:N 비율을 적지만, 상한 조건 뒤 문구는 두 위치 모두 `no DOP uptake`이다.
- 540–544·1170–1178: `LtracerSponge`의 기대값 차원은 설정 앞 주석에서 `[Ngrids]`, 용어집에서 `[1:NBT,1:Ngrids]`이다. 설정은 `LtracerSponge == 61*F`이다.
- 68–79·827–832: 827행은 `This file is configured for Nphy=1 and Ngrids=1.`이라고 적는다. 식물플랑크톤 입력은 네 값을 제시하고, 829–832행 목록은 네 그룹을 제시한다.
- 747–754·829–830: idbio 목록은 그룹 1을 `Small diatom`, 그룹 2를 `Large diatom`으로 적는다. 식물플랑크톤 순서 설명은 `[1] larger diatoms`, `[2] small diatoms`로 적는다.
- 230–234·939–941: `b_PacEff`의 0 값 설명은 앞쪽에서 `no change in package effect`, 용어집에서 `no package effect`이다.
- 267–271·966–968: `b_PSC` 단위는 설정 설명에서 `microgram_PSC/microgram_Chl_a`, 용어집에서 `microgram_Chl_c/microgram_Chl_a`이다.
- 396–404·1057–1063: 설정 앞 주석은 `BacTbase`와 `BacTfac`를 세균 온도 매개변수로 적는다. 용어집의 두 설명은 `Phytoplankton`이라고 적는다.
- 552·1196–1198: 수반 기반 수직 혼합 규모 계수의 설정 키워드는 `ad_AKT_BAK`, 용어집 키워드는 `ad_AKT_fac`이다.
- 665·1460–1467: QUICKSAVE 설정은 `Qout(idzslT)`를 쓴다. QUICKSAVE 용어집의 일정 수심 단면 항목은 `Hout(idzslT)`를 쓴다(1465).
- 709·1527: 총 후방 산란 진단의 설정 키워드는 `Dout(idbTOT)`, 용어집 키워드는 `Dout(ibbTOT)`이다.
- 695–696·1513–1514: 수중 광학 진단 출력의 설정 앞 주석은 `time-averaged`, 용어집은 `Time-accumulated`라고 적는다.
